title: Skeleton and Woman in Field
description: A woman in a white dress lies on her side in a vast golden wheat field at night, her eyes closed and hand resting on the ribcage of a human skeleton positioned beside her. Glowing blue and purple mushrooms surround them both, with scattered broken pottery and bones in the foreground under a starry sky with streaking meteors.
prompt: A woman in a flowing white dress lies peacefully on her side in a vast golden wheat field at night, her hand resting on the ribcage of a full human skeleton lying beside her. They are surrounded by clusters of glowing bioluminescent blue and purple mushrooms. Broken pottery shards and bones are scattered in the foreground. The dark starry sky above features streaking meteors, creating a surreal and melancholic atmosphere.
